workflow: When subagents hit persistent 529 errors, falling back to inline execution in the orchestrator context is a viable recovery strategy.
The gsd plan-phase workflow involves: research → validation file → spawn planner agent → verify. The Nyquist validation step can be skipped under session stress without blocking progress.
Killing a stuck background agent with TaskStop is necessary before retrying or falling back to inline work.
Waiting a few minutes before retrying after 529s is the recommended approach when the API is overloaded.
